experimental_setup: RGB English/Chinese splits; synthetic noise ratios 0.0–0.8, negative rejection, information integration, counterfactuals
metric_and_denominator: Lenient substring accuracy / EM across all test queries
verified_finding: Reader accuracy degrades monotonically as hard-negative noise ratio increases; models struggle with negative rejection and counterfactual resistance

experimental_setup: KILT QA (NQ, TQA, HotpotQA, ELI5) & FEVER; DPR top-5 passages filtered for FLAN-T5-XL and Llama-2-7B readers (compared against full-context and FiD baselines)
metric_and_denominator: Exact Match (EM), F1, and prompt token reduction ratio
verified_finding: Sentence-level context filtering via STRINC/LEXICAL/CXMI cuts prompt tokens by ~2–3x while improving EM over unfiltered top-k passages

experimental_setup: NQ, TriviaQA, HotpotQA; MS-MARCO Contriever top-5 Wikipedia passages compressed via extractive dual-encoder or distilled abstractive T5-Large with null gate
metric_and_denominator: Exact Match (EM) and retrieved passage tokens on Flan-UL2 (Table 2, CIs not reported): NQ 660->37 tokens (39.39->36.57 EM, -2.82 pp extractive; 56 tokens, 37.04 EM abstractive); TQA 677->38 tokens (62.37->58.99 EM, -3.38 pp); HotpotQA 684->75 tokens (32.80->30.40 EM, -2.40 pp)
verified_finding: Compresses retrieved passage tokens by 9–18x (to 5%–11% of top-5 tokens) with a -2.40 to -3.38 pp extractive EM change on Flan-UL2; null gate abstains from prepending context when utility is negative

source_location: Yu et al. (NeurIPS 2024), §3 & §4.3, Tables 1–3, AppendixOverhead Analysis
experimental_setup: KILT OpenQA, Multi-hop QA, FaithDial, Biomedical QA; unified instruction-tuned Llama-3-8B/70B backbone
metric_and_denominator: Exact Match (EM), token F1, and two-stage retrieve-rerank-generate latency
verified_finding: Unifies ranking and generation weights in one LLM, executing O(N) candidate relevance-scoring passes followed by 1x top-k generation pass

experimental_setup: LongBench Multi-Hop QA (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue); dual-perspective CoT chunk filter (I_d) + global extractor (I_g)
metric_and_denominator: Token F1 on LongBench multi-hop splits
verified_finding: Combining local CoT-filtered chunks with LLM-extracted global context improves multi-hop F1 over standard chunking and long-context baselines

experimental_setup: RAG-Bench (NQ, TQA, WebQ); Llama-2-7B on test queries pre-filtered to contain >=2 gold contexts in top-k (§4.1), paired with irrelevant, relevant hard-negative, and counterfactual noise
metric_and_denominator: Strict Exact Match (EM) across Golden Only vs. 3 noise strata in 1x decoding call
verified_finding: On gold-present reader splits, bounds EM drop from Golden Only (83.07) to Counterfactual Noise (82.10, -0.97 pp vs. -16.19 pp unadapted); does not evaluate retrieval omissions where gold is absent

experimental_setup: Noisy NQ, TriviaQA, WebQ, RealTimeQA; DPR top-k + Llama-2-7B emitting reading notes prior to answer
metric_and_denominator: Exact Match (EM), F1, and unknown-rejection rate
verified_finding: Intermediate passage-level relevance notes improve noise robustness and unanswerable rejection within 1x decoding call at the cost of extra output tokens

experimental_setup: FaithEval, RealtimeQA, NQ-Swap, ConFiQA; Llama-3.1, Qwen-2.5, GLM-4 backbones
metric_and_denominator: Substring / conflict-resolution accuracy across counterfactual splits
verified_finding: Self-knowledge elicitation and atomic fact alignment outperform full-context and CoT prompting under parametric-context conflicts

experimental_setup: NQ, TriviaQA, BioASQ, PopQA; Gemini and Claude backbones with iterative internal-external passage clustering
metric_and_denominator: String accuracy across noisy and conflicting retrieval
verified_finding: Iterative source-reliability-weighted consolidation reconciles internal and external knowledge without weight fine-tuning

experimental_setup: White-box open-weight LLMs on counterfactual context adherence splits
metric_and_denominator: Context Adherence Rate (ConR) and Memorization Rate (MR); 1x decoding call (ParamMute) vs. 2x decoding calls (CoRect)
verified_finding: ParamMute suppresses FFN neurons in 1x decoding call; CoRect contrasts full-context and null-context states across 2x decoding calls

source_location: Zou et al. (USENIX Security 2025), Tables 1 & 4; CorruptRAG §4
experimental_setup: NQ, HotpotQA, MS-MARCO; m<=k (e.g., m=5 in top-5) vs. single-passage m=1 injection
metric_and_denominator: Empirical Attack Success Rate (ASR) over target queries
verified_finding: Coupling retrieval promotion with generation steering achieves high empirical ASR

experimental_setup: Poisoned NQ, HotpotQA, MS-MARCO; Stage-1 k-means filtering + Stage-2 self-assessment
metric_and_denominator: Empirical ASR and clean QA accuracy
verified_finding: Two-stage filtering lowers empirical poisoning ASR while preserving clean accuracy, without formal worst-case certificates

source_location: Xiang et al. (ICML 2024, arXiv:2405.15556v2), Definition 1, Algorithms 3–4, Tables I–III, Appendix Grouping Analysis
experimental_setup: RQA, NQ, Biography; G=ceil(k/omega) isolated passage groups with Secure Keyword Aggregation (G isolated calls + 1 final synthesis call = G+1 LLM calls) or Secure Decoding Aggregation
metric_and_denominator: Worst-case task-metric lower bound min_{C'} M(y_hat_{C'}, y*) >= tau (Certifiable Accuracy cacc for tau=1 on QA), empirical ASR, and online latency (1.16–3.65x); offline certification enumerates worst-case group shifts
verified_finding: Certifies that all outputs reachable under <=k' poisoned passages achieve task evaluation score >= tau (without requiring identical keyword sets or token strings across perturbations)

metric_and_denominator: Lenient inclusion accuracy, PubHealth accuracy, and citation precision/recall

metric_and_denominator: Accuracy and FactScore across RAG and Self-CRAG pairings
verified_finding: Post-retrieval evaluator routing repairs low-quality initial retrieval across both standard RAG and Self-RAG

experimental_setup: TriviaQA, PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, FreshQA; honesty steering + online token-level confidence probing during generation
metric_and_denominator: QA accuracy and adaptive segment trigger efficiency
verified_finding: Monitors token-level confidence representation directions online during decoding to trigger segment-level search and regeneration

experimental_setup: HotpotQA, MuSiQue, FreshQA; Gemini-1.5-Pro sufficient-context autorater + model confidence thresholding
metric_and_denominator: Selective accuracy vs. coverage on answered subset
verified_finding: Pairing sufficiency classification with confidence lowers selective hallucination rate across coverage levels

source_location: Yoran et al. (ICLR 2024); Cuconasu et al. (SIGIR 2024); Liu et al. (CoRM-RAG 2026)
experimental_setup: OpenQA (NQ, TQA) and multi-hop QA under hard negatives vs. random noise
metric_and_denominator: EM/F1 degradation under hard negatives; counterfactual doc-query utility
verified_finding: Empirical regularity: hard negatives degrade readers more than random text; Open hypothesis: extending doc-query counterfactual utility to joint subset optimization with local multi-hop complementarity

experimental_setup: Single-hop counterfactual adherence (ConFiQA) vs. noise/poisoning splits
metric_and_denominator: Context Adherence Rate vs. ASR and noise invariance
verified_finding: Empirical: Context-DPO/ParamMute raise single-hop context adherence while Parenting shows gradient conflict with noise invariance; Mechanistic inference: unconditional FFN muting risks impairing unretrieved multi-hop bridges

source_location: FILCO (rrag044), RECOMP (rrag226), Zhao et al. financial RAG audit (venueExpanded073)
experimental_setup: Single-hop (NQ, TQA) and multi-hop (HotpotQA) compression vs. premise loss
metric_and_denominator: Token compression (2–3x in FILCO, 9–18x in RECOMP) vs. EM drop
verified_finding: Empirical: aggressive compression reduces passage tokens (9–18x in RECOMP Table 2) with extractive/abstractive EM drop on multi-hop spans; Design direction: soft reliability tokens + parallel KV

experimental_setup: Multi-step search and multi-agent debate under token/call budgets
metric_and_denominator: Accuracy gain vs. O(T*M) or O(ceil(k/omega)) decoding calls
verified_finding: Empirical: iterative loops repair initial retrieval misses but waste budget on true corpus gaps; Normative direction: dual-calibrated CPOMDP VoI routing

experimental_setup: i.i.d. conformal calibration vs. multi-turn adaptive retrieval and code calibration
metric_and_denominator: Marginal set coverage (1-alpha) vs. singleton selective risk (<= alpha_r)
verified_finding: Theoretical/empirical: i.i.d. selective risk control (BalanceRAG) differs from marginal set coverage (URAG); Open hypothesis: transferring neuro-symbolic confidence scoring to covariate-shift RAG

source_location: Capabilities: ColPali, TableRAG, G-Retriever, ChatQA 1/2, CoE; Attacks: Poisoned-MRAG (rrag229), LogicPoison (rrag127), AgentPoison (rrag053), MemoryGraft (rrag188)
